carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and deep shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The anterior region posterior to the eye exhibits a vermiculated patterning of high-intensity pixels forming complex, interconnected labyrinthine lines rather than discrete circular blobs.
